# snipeit_user (Resource)

Manages a user in Snipe-IT.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "snipeit_group" "helpdesk" {
  name = "Helpdesk"
}

resource "snipeit_user" "jdoe" {
  username   = "jdoe"
  first_name = "Jane"
  last_name  = "Doe"
  password   = var.initial_password
  email      = "jane.doe@example.com"
  jobtitle   = "IT Support"
  activated  = true
  groups     = [snipeit_group.helpdesk.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `first_name` (String) First name of the user.
- `username` (String) Login name of the user. Must be unique.

### Optional

- `activated` (Boolean) Whether the user can log in.
- `company_id` (Number) Id of the company the user belongs to.
- `department_id` (Number) Id of the department the user belongs to.
- `email` (String) Email address of the user.
- `employee_num` (String) Employee number of the user.
- `groups` (Set of Number) Set of permission group ids the user belongs to.
- `jobtitle` (String) Job title of the user.
- `last_name` (String) Last name of the user.
- `location_id` (Number) Id of the location of the user.
- `manager_id` (Number) Id of the user's manager.
- `notes` (String) Free-form notes.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password of the user. Write-only: the API never returns it, so the configured value is kept in state as-is. Required by the API when creating a user. After `terraform import` this attribute is null and only re-set when changed in configuration.
- `phone` (String) Phone number of the user.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the user.
